Name: 211 Helpline
Description: Dial 211 to connect with local health and human services — food, shelter, utility assistance, and more.

Name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
Description: Free, confidential crisis support for anyone in suicidal crisis or emotional distress. Call or text 988.

Name: CVDVS London (Cumberland Valley Domestic Violence Services)
Address: London, Laurel County, Kentucky (specific street address not published on website)
Description: Cumberland Valley Domestic Violence Services, Inc. provides 24/7 safe shelter and domestic violence advocacy for residents and non-residential clients across 8 Kentucky counties; named 2025 Non-Profit of the Year by the London–Laurel County Chamber of Commerce. Eligibility: All services free of charge for participants and their dependent children; no income eligibility standards
